optic.display_name: Plano-convex lens, D12.7 mm, f = 100 mm, N-BK7, AR 400-1100 nm
optic.display_name_zh_cn: 平凸透镜，直径 12.7 mm，焦距 100 mm，N-BK7，增透膜 400-1100 nm

chain.display_name: Optic mount for 12.7 mm round optics, fixed, axis 15 mm
chain.display_name_zh_cn: 光学元件安装架，适用于 12.7 毫米圆形光学元件，固定式，光轴高度 15 毫米
光学支杆，直径 12.7 毫米，长 50 毫米

chain.display_name: Post holder with integrated fork base, 75 mm
chain.display_name_zh_cn: 带一体式叉块底座的支杆座，高 75 毫米

steps.text: Seat the optic OS-OPT-LENS-PCX-D12P7-F100-T2P2-R51P5-NBK7-AR400-1100-W587P6 in the mount OS-MECH-OPTIC-MOUNT-FIXED-D12P7-H15 (OD12.7-SEAT).
steps.text_zh_cn: 将光学元件 OS-OPT-LENS-PCX-D12P7-F100-T2P2-R51P5-NBK7-AR400-1100-W587P6 装入镜架 OS-MECH-OPTIC-MOUNT-FIXED-D12P7-H15（OD12.7-SEAT）。

steps.text: Screw the mount OS-MECH-OPTIC-MOUNT-FIXED-D12P7-H15 onto the post OS-MECH-POST-D12P7-L50 with the post's top stud (M4x0.7).
steps.text_zh_cn: 用支杆顶端的螺柱（M4x0.7）把镜架 OS-MECH-OPTIC-MOUNT-FIXED-D12P7-H15 拧到支杆 OS-MECH-POST-D12P7-L50 上。

steps.text: Insert the post into the post holder OS-MECH-POST-HOLDER-FORK-L75 (OD12.7-POST) to 40 mm and lock it.
steps.text_zh_cn: 将支杆插入支杆座 OS-MECH-POST-HOLDER-FORK-L75（OD12.7-POST），插入深度 40 mm，锁紧。

steps.text: Fix the post holder on a hole of the surface with one M6x1.0 screw through its base slot; with the slot along the beam it slides along the beam.
steps.text_zh_cn: 用一颗 M6x1.0 螺钉穿过支杆座底座的槽，把支杆座固定在台面的螺孔上；槽沿光束方向时可沿光束微调位置。

height_arithmetic.text: Holder 75 mm + post 50 mm + mount axis height 15 mm − insertion 40 mm = beam height 100 mm.
height_arithmetic.text_zh_cn: 支杆座高 75 mm + 支杆长 50 mm + 镜架光轴高 15 mm − 插入深度 40 mm = 光轴高度 100 mm。

adjustment_axes: Tz (BASE_SLOT_TRAVEL, -12.5 / +12.5 mm, holder slot along the beam)
adjustment_axes_zh_cn: Tz (BASE_SLOT_TRAVEL, -12.5 / +12.5 mm, 支杆座的槽沿光束方向)

adjustments.text: Tx: not provided by this hardware; fixed when assembled.
adjustments.text_zh_cn: Tx：这组光机不提供该调节，装配时固定。

adjustments.text: Ty: slide the post in its holder, -10 / +15 mm.
adjustments.text_zh_cn: Ty：在支杆座中上下滑动支杆，-10 / +15 mm。

adjustments.text: Tz: move the holder along its base slot (slot along the beam), -12.5 / +12.5 mm.
adjustments.text_zh_cn: Tz：沿底座槽移动支杆座（槽沿光束方向时），-12.5 / +12.5 mm。

checks.text: The mount holds the optic (shape, size, thickness, clear aperture) and does not clip the beam at the design's angle.
checks.text_zh_cn: 镜架能夹持该元件（形状、尺寸、厚度、通光孔径），且在设计的入射角下不遮挡光束。

checks.text: Holder height, post length, mount axis height and insertion depth give the stated beam height.
checks.text_zh_cn: 支杆座高度、支杆长度、镜架光轴高度和插入深度合起来正好是所述光轴高度。

checks.text: The post diameter fits the holder clamp; the post thread fits the mount's interface.
checks.text_zh_cn: 支杆直径与支杆座夹持孔一致；支杆螺纹与镜架接口一致。

checks.text: The parts of the set do not intersect outside their contacts.
checks.text_zh_cn: 这组零件之间除接触面外没有干涉。

checks.text: The post holder's insertion range is an assumed value, so the insertion depth is not checked against a measured range.
checks.text_zh_cn: 支杆座允许的插入深度范围是假定值，因此插入深度未按实测范围检查。

checks.text: The part outlines rest on accepted facts.
checks.text_zh_cn: 零件外形依据已确认的数据。

checks.text: No layout: spacing to other optics and hardware, the beam beyond this optic and fixing hole positions are not checked.
checks.text_zh_cn: 没有布局：未检查与其他元件和光机的间距、元件之后的光路以及固定孔的位置。

assumptions.text: The post holder's insertion range is an assumed value.
assumptions.text_zh_cn: 支杆座允许的插入深度范围是假定值。

conditions.text: The slide along the beam needs the holder fixed with its slot along the beam.
conditions.text_zh_cn: 沿光束方向的位置调节要求支杆座的槽沿光束方向固定。

units.text: OS-OPT-LENS-PCX-D12P7-F100-T2P2-R51P5-NBK7-AR400-1100-W587P6, 1 unit(s), beam height 100 mm, angle of incidence 0°.
units.text_zh_cn: OS-OPT-LENS-PCX-D12P7-F100-T2P2-R51P5-NBK7-AR400-1100-W587P6，1 件，光轴高度 100 mm，入射角 0°。

notes.text: Every height is measured from the surface the post holders stand on (the top of a breadboard or table).
notes.text_zh_cn: 所有高度都从支杆座所立的平面（面包板或台面的上表面）量起。

notes.text: These optics are ordered from your design: its optical function and the optics' relative positions passed its Local Validation.
notes.text_zh_cn: 这些光学元件按您的设计订购，设计的光学功能和元件之间的相对位置已由本地验证确认。

notes.text: Collisions between the hardware of different optics are not checked.
notes.text_zh_cn: 未检查不同元件的光机之间是否碰撞。

notes.text: Whether other hardware blocks the beam is not checked.
notes.text_zh_cn: 未检查光路是否被其他光机遮挡。

notes.text: The fixing hole positions on your surface are not checked.
notes.text_zh_cn: 未检查台面上固定孔的位置。
